chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from some of our companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'I will intercede on the Day of Resurrection for four types of people, even if they come with the sins of the people of the world: A man who supported my offspring, a man who spent his wealth for my offspring in times of hardship, a man who loved my offspring with his tongue and his heart, and a man who strove to fulfill the needs of my offspring when they were expelled and scattered.'
ai.seo_question: Who are the four types of people for whom the Prophet will intercede on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the eschatological significance of *Wala'* (loyalty) to the Ahl al-Bayt, categorizing support into material, emotional, and active advocacy. It underscores the Shia belief that the Prophet’s intercession is contingent upon this devotion, offering a spiritual guarantee of salvation even for those with significant sins. The narration serves as a foundational text for the obligation of supporting the Imams and their descendants in both times of ease and hardship.
